Field.Name: MsgRefID
Field.Description: Numeric value (from 0 to 64,999) that will be echoed back on the acknowledgement response for this update only. Can be used to correlate responses with submission messages for a given symbol.

Field.Name: UpdateType
Field.Description: Specifies whether adding a new or updating an existing quote. Valid Values: 1 = Update Quote 2 = Add Quote

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Identifying symbol for security. If the optional 48/22 tags are not sent, this tag will be required. If the optional 48/22 tags are sent as well, this tag will be ignored.

Field.Name: SymbolSfx
Field.Description: Optional Symbol Suffix

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Alternate ID value for security instead of symbol. To be used in conjunction with tag IDSource. If optional tag 55 is not sent, this tag will be required.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: The type of alternate ID specified in tag 48. If optional tag 55 is not sent, this tag will be required. Valid Values: 1 = CUSIP

Field.Name: ATSOnly
Field.Description: Valid values: Y = Quote can only be disseminated within OTC Link

Field.Name: CATroutedQuoteID
Field.Description: A unique identifier, max 40 alphanumeric characters. Optional ID to be used in the routedQuoteID of the CAT Routed Quote Event message (MERQ). Bid Side Properties, if none are provided then bid remains unchanged on Update Quote, and price is set to unpriced on Add Quote

Field.Name: BidPriceType
Field.Description: The price type code for the bid side. Valid Values: A = Actual U = Unpriced OW = Offers Wanted

Field.Name: BidPx
Field.Description: The price for the bid side. Ignored, when BidPriceType = U or OW. If BidPx = 0, when BidPriceType = A or is absent, bid quote becomes unpriced. Can include up to 6 decimals, for enabled digital asset securities.

Field.Name: BidSize
Field.Description: The number of shares on the bid side. Ignored, when BidPriceType = U or OW, or if BidPx = 0. Required, when BidPriceType = A or is absent, and BidPx > 0. Can include up to 6 decimals, for symbols enabled for fractional shares.

Field.Name: BidQAPRate
Field.Description: The QAP rate for the bid side of the quote. If this tag is omitted, the firm default value will be used for new quotes, or left unchanged for existing quotes. Values range from -30 to +30 for stocks and -300 to +300 for bonds

Field.Name: BidAutoEx
Field.Description: Indicates whether or not bid side quote is indicated as Auto-Ex. Valid Values: Y = Quote is Auto-Ex indicated N = Quote is not Auto-Ex indicated (Default) Offer Side Properties, if none are provided then offer remains unchanged on Update Quote, and price is set to unpriced on Add Quote

Field.Name: OfferPriceType
Field.Description: The price type code for the offer side. Valid Values: A = Actual U = Unpriced BW = Bids Wanted

Field.Name: OfferPx
Field.Description: The price for the offer side. Ignored, when OfferPriceType = U or BW. If OfferPx = 0, when OfferPriceType = A or is absent, offer quote becomes unpriced. Can include up to 6 decimals, for enabled digital asset securities.

Field.Name: OfferSize
Field.Description: The number of shares on the offer side. Ignored, when OfferPriceType = U or BW, or if OfferPx = 0. Required, when OfferPriceType = A or is absent, and OfferPx > 0. Can include up to 6 decimals, for symbols enabled for fractional shares.

Field.Name: OfferQAPRate
Field.Description: The QAP rate for the offer side of the quote. If this tag is omitted, the firm default value will be used for new quotes, or left unchanged for existing quotes. Values range from -30 to +30 for stocks and -300 to +300 for bonds

Field.Name: OfferAutoEx
Field.Description: Indicates whether or not offer side quote is indicated as Auto-Ex. Valid Values: Y = Quote is Auto-Ex indicated N = Quote is not Auto-Ex indicated (Default) Optional parameters. With exception of LockCrossFlag, parameters are retained from last quote message if none is provided.

Field.Name: LockCrossFlag
Field.Description: Indicates if this Quote message is allowed to lock/crossing the market for a particular security. Valid Values: Y = Can lock/cross N = Cannot lock/cross (Default)

Field.Name: Unsolicited
Field.Description: Indicates whether or not a quote is unsolicited. Can only be set on quote add. Original value must be included on quote update. Valid Values: Y = Quote is unsolicited N = Quote is not unsolicited (Default)

Field.Name: Non-Affiliate
Field.Description: Required, if Unsolicited = Y. Indicates whether or not an unsolicited quote is from a Non- Affiliate. Can only be set on quote add. For securities that require the Non-Affiliate flag, original value must be included on quote update. Valid Values: Y = Unsolicited quote is from a Non- Affiliate N = Unsolicited quote is not from a Non- Affiliate (Default)

Field.Name: FractionalShareTrad eMessagesAccepted
Field.Description: A flag indicating if quoting trader can accept fractional size trade messages, for symbols enabled for fractional size. Valid Values: Y = Fractional size trade messages accepted N = Fractional size trade messages not accepted (Default)

Field.Name: CancelTime
Field.Description: Indicates time in HH:MM:SS in UTC when quote should be cancelled. Default = blank (no expire) (Future implementation)

Field.Name: AutoCancelEOD
Field.Description: A flag indicating if quote should be cancelled at 17:00:00 UTC. (Future implementation). Valid Values: Y = Quote should be cancelled N = Quote should not be cancelled (Default) Reserved TAGS

Field.Name: MsgRefID
Field.Description: Numeric value (from 0 to 64,999) that will be echoed back on the acknowledgement response for this cancel only.

Field.Name: OpenCloseState
Field.Description: Code to indicate if trader wishes to open or close his quotes. Valid values: 1 = Open this trader only 2 = Close this trader only 3 = Open all traders 4 = Close all traders
